questions.question: How did the Ammonites insult David's envoys?
options: They killed them outright and sent back their dead bodies
They shaved off half their beards and cut their garments
They imprisoned them all in the deep city dungeon
They robbed them of all their gifts and their gold
questions.answer: They shaved off half their beards and cut their garments
